name: Celestial Rebuke
body:
School evocation [good, fire]; Level cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Target attacking creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You pull fire from the heavens to strike any who would deign to attack you. When activated, the creature that targeted you with an attack or offensive ability or spell is dealt 1d4 damage per caster level (maximum 5d4). Half of the damage dealt is fire damage and the other half is divine damage and is not subject to energy resistance or immunity.
